maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly subscriptions to financial data, analytics and workstation software for investment firms, not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are asset managers, banks, wealth advisors and corporations paying private-sector subscriptions for financial data and analytics.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from selling subscriptions and developing data and analytics products, with only occasional tuck-in acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: FactSet Workstation, portfolio analytics and data feeds are embedded in investment workflows and systems; switching means migration, retraining and integration disruption.
